name: gsp_introduce
description: Introduce an agent to the Gossip mesh: registers session, broadcasts an announcement to all peers, and returns an instant onboarding briefing (goals, pending tasks, active SOP gates, caution rules, and disclosed peers)

capabilities.description: List of capability tags or skills

current_task_id.description: Task ID currently being worked on

greeting.description: Optional custom greeting or introduction message broadcast to all peers

remote_endpoint.description: Optional remote tunnel or LAN endpoint if agent is running remotely

role.description: Agent role (orchestrator, worker, network_engineer, math_expert, systems_architect, security_specialist, qa_engineer, researcher, red_team, critic)
